sections.heading: Where are your books sold?
sections.body: Sales are handled by redirection to Amazon: you leave this site to complete your order. BARMAJATA is not involved in payment, delivery or after-sales service.

sections.heading: Why might the price here differ from Amazon's?
sections.body: The price shown on this site is the public price set by the publisher. In France, the fixed book price law allows retailers a discount of at most 5%, so the gap cannot exceed that.

books.amazonNotice: The sale is completed by Amazon, on its own site and under its own terms. BARMAJATA is not involved in payment, delivery or after-sales service.
